|lore=It’s the lure of easy credits. It’s got a very strong appeal. Perhaps you’d understand better wearing my flight suit. It’s the ultimate special modification, it’s the smuggler’s blues.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at any battleground where you have two musicians or two smugglers (or one of each). Once per turn, may take Han’s Back, Han’s Dice, Solo Han, Special Modifications, or Stay Sharp into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle!.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Smuggler's Blues (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Smuggler's Blues (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 1, slip 8 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Deploy on table. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at any battleground where you have two smugglers or two musicians (or one of each). Once per turn, you may ▲ Han's Back, Han's Dice, Solo Han, Stay Sharp!, or Special Modifications.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•8” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf], Internet Archive 5 December 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS7-08-Smugglers_Blues-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 8), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Opponent may not cancel or modify Force drains at any battleground where you have two musicians or two smugglers (or one of each). Once per turn, may take Han’s Back, Han’s Dice, Solo Han, Special Modifications, or Stay Sharp into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle!.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
